summary.text: Dean Murray is a Republican member of the New York State Senate who has represented District 3 since January 2023 and is running for re-election on the Republican and Conservative lines.
He previously served in the New York State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Dean Murray graduated from the Broadcast Institute of Maryland, according to Ballotpedia.

His professional experience includes owning D&S Advertising Incorporated, working as a regional sales manager and an advertising sales representative, working in radio and television news, and volunteering with the Suffolk County Police Reserves.
Murray represented Assembly District 3 from 2014 to 2019, according to Ballotpedia, and he entered the Senate in 2023.
In the 2025 to 2026 session he is ranking member of the Commerce, Economic Development and Small Business, Libraries, and Social Services committees.
